name: Glabrezu
notes: CR 9. Magic Resistance. Innate spellcasting: darkness, dispel magic, detect magic at will; confusion, fly, power word stun 1/day. Multiattack: 2 pincers (grapple) + 2 fists vs grappled targets.
gm_notes: Session 4 -- Blood Cult Dungeon, Core Room final guardian. Bound to the crystal-star focus, not just placed near it. Opens with Darkness over the dais, then isolates whoever gets closest with Power Word Stun.
